events.kind: statutory arrangement letting the government set the bank's exchange rate policy
events.summary: Under section 29 of the Bank of Guyana Act, Chapter 85:02 (Act No. 19 of 1998, enacted 31 December 1998), the Minister, in consultation with the Bank, specifies the policies, principles and criteria of Guyana's exchange rate system, and the Bank is responsible only for the day-to-day administration of that system. Section 14(2) of the same Act lets the President terminate the appointment of the Governor, and the Minister terminate the appointment of any other Director, on stated grounds. Section 3(1) describes the Bank as an autonomous institution governed by the Act. This record rests on the consolidated text of the Act published by Guyana's Ministry of Legal Affairs.
events.source_title: Laws of Guyana, Volume 16, Chapters 83.01-89.01: Bank of Guyana Act, Cap. 85:02 (Ministry of Legal Affairs, Guyana)
events.quote: the Bank shall be responsible for the day-to-day administration of such system

parties.role: holds the statutory power to specify the exchange rate system's policies, principles and criteria
may terminate the Governor's appointment under section 14(2)

events.kind: statutory arrangement letting the government order an investigation of the bank
events.summary: Section 66(2) of the Bank of Namibia Act, 2020 (Act 1 of 2020) lets the Minister, on reasonable grounds, direct the Auditor-General to investigate and report on the Bank's accounts or affairs, and obliges the Bank to give the Auditor-General the information and facilities requested. Section 66(3) requires the Auditor-General's report to follow the Minister's directives and to be submitted to the Minister. The same Act, at section 5, says the Bank must act without direction from any person or authority and makes interference with its independence an offence.
events.source_title: Bank of Namibia Act 1 of 2020 (Namibia Legal Information Institute)
events.quote: the Minister may, if there are reasonable grounds to do so, direct that the Auditor-General investigate

parties.role: may direct an investigation of the bank's accounts or affairs and set the terms of the report
investigates and reports on the bank when so directed

events.kind: statutory arrangement letting the executive overrule and remove the bank's board
events.summary: Article 197 of the Constitution of Uruguay provides that where the Poder Ejecutivo considers the management or acts of the Directores of an ente autonomo inconvenient or unlawful it may make observations and suspend the acts observed, and that if the observations are disregarded it may order the rectifications, correctives or removals it sees fit, reporting them to the Senate. Article 198 adds that the Poder Ejecutivo may remove board members with the Senate's consent for ineptitude, omission or crime in office, that if the Senate does not rule within sixty days the Poder Ejecutivo may make the removal effective, and that such removals give no right of appeal to the Tribunal de lo Contencioso Administrativo. The Banco Central del Uruguay is an ente autonomo, and article 14 of its charter designates its directors under article 187 of this same chapter.
events.source_title: Constitucion de la Republica de Uruguay, Seccion XI, Capitulo I (Justia Uruguay)
events.quote: el Poder Ejecutivo podra disponer las rectificaciones, los correctivos o remociones que considere del caso

parties.role: may suspend the board's acts and order rectifications, correctives or removals
consents to removals, and loses the decision if it does not rule within sixty days

events.summary: A report published on 26 May 2017 said the Supervisory Board of the Central Bank of Curacao and Sint Maarten had voted three to two to extend a managing director's term, short of the supermajority required, and that the finance minister, Richard Gibson, had written to the board members Robert Pietersz, Tom Kok, Miriela Carolina, Vance Williams and Hubert Lopez asking them to work on a solution. The report quotes him saying that if a solution could not be found there would be no other choice but dismissal of the board. The report does not say who would carry out the dismissal.
events.source_title: Impasse on extending term of Central Bank Managing Director (Curacao Chronicle, reprinted by Knipselkrant Curacao)
events.quote: If one cannot be found, there will be "no other choice, but dismissal" of the board, he said.

parties.role: wrote to the bank's supervisory board and warned of its dismissal
